'''Tully Owens''' was the chief [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] operating the docking piers in [[Cjaalysce'I]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Owens was also responsible for overseeing the production lines for the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]. A former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], Owens was renowned for his engineering prowess, jury-rigging [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] and overhauling battery weapon emplacements. He was recruited into Caelli-Merced by [[Tait Ransom]] and soon proved his worth.<ref name="BSS" />
